name: ai-secure-file-transfer-system
description: Root runner for MERN + Python AI microservice

scripts.install:all: npm run install:node && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:python
scripts.install:python: cd backend && (if not exist venv python -m venv venv) && .\venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:node" "npm run start:python" "npm run start:frontend"
